notes: The first Level 1 regression run exposed a test focus race after closing its automatic guide. The helper now waits for the documented next-frame focus restoration before sending a keyboard action; the complete suite then passed.

The first clean dependency install could not write to the managed home npm cache. A writable /tmp cache resolved it; lockfile integrity and TLS checks stayed enabled. Both builds passed after the clean install.

The 41 real-time Level 2 offline checks and Level 1 regressions precede the final metadata correction and background-counter elapsed-time clamp. The final source passed the 8 partner integration checks; the exact packaged HTML passed the offline release flow with normal motion.
Browser-clock integration/release tests exercise contracts and the final package. The main Level 2, Level 1, feedback and guide suites use real reading intervals.
Offline tests use the exact HTML through an in-memory HTTPS route because this managed browser blocks file:// navigation. A particular user browser opening a local download was not directly tested.
Partner cinematics and opening remain placeholders or separate source. Level 3 gameplay and classroom network-load testing are outside this build.
